title: Ask for Something Huge First — Then Watch Them Say Yes to What You Actually Want
description:
Ask for something huge. Get rejected. Then ask for what you actually wanted — and watch the yes rate nearly triple. Cialdini's 1975 door-in-the-face experiment is one of the most useful persuasion findings in psychology. This video breaks down how it works, where it's used against you, and how to protect your own decision-making.

**What you'll learn:**
• What the door-in-the-face technique is and why Cialdini discovered it
• The mechanism: reciprocal concession and contrast effect
• Where you're already encountering this (car dealerships, salary negotiations, relationships)
• How to use it ethically — and defend against it
